D: Tony is pushed to the edge when a mysterious terrorist destroys his home and he has to fight back without his suits.
P: Serve the mains when Tony is stranded in the snow in Tennessee.
S: Tony stranded in the snow in small-town Tennessee
Popcorn tossed with melted white chocolate and a pinch of salt, spread out to set and broken into clusters.
Harley helping Tony in his garage
Cheese and crackers, pretzels and apple slices on a tray, quick to grab while fixing the suit.
the cliff-top house in Malibu before the helicopters hit it
Big prawns butterflied, tossed with garlic, chilli, lemon zest and olive oil, grilled 2 minutes a side over high heat, piled on a platter with lemon aioli.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in buttermilk, fried crisp, brushed with a hot oil of cayenne, brown sugar and paprika, on white bread with pickles.
Turkey breast rolled with sage and onion stuffing, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with roast potatoes and cranberry sauce.
W: the enormous stuffed bunny Tony gives Pepper
Vanilla sponge baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in white icing and shredded coconut, with marshmallow ears.
K: Harley's Tennessee town, snowed in at Christmas
Old-fashioned chocolate malted milkshakes, thick enough to stand a straw in. Blend 1L chocolate ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 6 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth.

s.note: Tony stranded in the snow in small-town Tennessee
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn and toss with 30g melted butter. Spread on a lined tray. Melt 200g white chocolate and drizzle all over, then sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt flakes. Leave to set for 30 minutes and break into clusters like snow.

s.note: the cliff-top house in Malibu before the helicopters hit it
s.how: Butterfly 600g green prawns and toss with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lemon zest and olive oil. Grill over high heat for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pile onto a platter and serve with mayonnaise mixed with lemon juice.

m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in buttermilk overnight. Dredge in seasoned flour and fry at 165C until crisp and cooked through. Whisk hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar and paprika and brush over the chicken. Serve on white bread with pickles.

w.note: the enormous stuffed bunny Tony gives Pepper
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 round tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Cut one round into ears and a bow tie, assemble into a bunny, cover in white icing and desiccated coconut and add marshmallows.

d.note: Harley's Tennessee town, snowed in at Christmas
d.how: Blend 1L chocolate ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 6 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 chilled glasses and dust with a little extra malt powder.
